subject: PR routing & Coupa supplier setup — next steps for Finera procurement
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vincent Luo <vincent.luo@finera.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement next steps and PR routing options

Hi Vincent —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and the options we discussed so we can align on the easiest commercial path for Finera:

- Marketplace (GCP/Azure): fast procurement if you already purchase via marketplace and prefer a managed billing flow.
- Direct PO/PR (Coupa/Ariba): standard for enterprise — requires vendor/supplier record in your procurement system (supplier ID).
- Credit card / P-card: short-term option for pilots or POCs with lower spend ceilings.

From our discussion it sounded like the primary path is going to be a PR/PO via Coupa. To move that forward we typically need: W9 (if US), SOC 2 summary, a vendor contact and the target payment terms (Net-30/Net-45). I attached the Q3 pricing recap for reference.

Can you confirm the following by EOD tomorrow if possible?
1) Do you have an existing supplier/vendor record for Redwood in Coupa or Ariba (supplier ID)?
2) Who is the procurement contact (email) we should send the vendor package to?
3) Is Finera able to accept standard Redwood terms or will procurement ask for redlines?
4) Any preference for marketplace vs direct PO? (You said PO likely — just confirming.)

If PR is the path, I will coordinate with our Finance/Legal to assemble the vendor package and open the internal PR onboarding ticket. If marketplace is preferred, Alex can scope the listing requirements.

Attachments: pricing_summary_Q3.pdf

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Vincent Luo <vincent.luo@finera.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement next steps and PR routing options

Laura —

Appreciate the clear recap. Confirming the procurement perspective from my side:

- Finera will prefer a PO/PR via Coupa. We try to avoid marketplace listings for new vendor engagements unless there is a compelling reason.
- We do not currently have a supplier record for Redwood in Coupa. Procurement will need vendor onboarding to create the supplier ID.
- Please send W9, SOC2 (redacted OK), and a contact for vendor invoicing.
- Procurement contact: procurement@finera.com (copying procurement alias for visibility).
- Timeline: Finance wants the supplier created and PR submitted by 2026-08-20 to meet internal quarter close cycles.

Can you also confirm your tax/legal entity (EIN) and the remit-to billing address to include on the vendor form? If you have a one-pager vendor package we can use to speed review that would help.

Thanks,
Vincent Luo
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Finera Inc.
vincent.luo@finera.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Procurement next steps and PR routing options

Team — forwarding Finera's procurement reply. Action items we need to move quickly to meet their 2026-08-20 target.

Key asks from Finera:
- Vendor package: W9, SOC2 summary (redacted is fine), remit-to billing address, EIN, primary billing contact.
- They will create a PR in Coupa once supplier has a record.

Proposed internal plan (please confirm):
1) Neha — can you approve standard Net-30 terms for this account and confirm the billing remit details? If we need contract redlines, flag Legal; otherwise we'll send the vendor package immediately.
2) Alex — can you confirm whether usage will be billed monthly as "consumption" (tokens/hour) vs seat-based subscription so procurement knows line-item wording for the PR? Also advise if we should pursue a Marketplace listing in parallel (I think Finera prefers PR, so marketplace is lower priority).
3) I will prepare the vendor package and W9 and open the procurement onboarding ticket in Jira (I will use PR-4821) — once Neha approves terms I will share the package with procurement@finera.com.

Notes on supplier ID mapping: Finera uses Coupa. When they create the supplier record we will capture the Coupa Supplier ID and store it on the deal record. If we end up supporting Ariba instead, the supplier number will go in the same field on our side (field: external_supplier_id). For internal tracking I will include both IDs in the Jira ticket.

Attachments: vendor_package_for_finera.zip (contains W9 and SOC2 redacted)

Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
